about_the_game:
Save the world with breakbeats.

ABOUT

On the surface, he is a superhero.

But in his true form, he is an up-and-coming DJ who keeps the clubs lively night after night.

His name is BrebeMan.

Every day, he plays breakbeats from two records and defends the world.

Of course, he never misses to proselytize breakbeat sound.

When you finish this game, you will be hooked on breakbeats.

This is the true music game.

SYSTEM

"BrebeMan" is a 3D SHMUPS & music game.

You control the superhero “BrebeMan” and defeat the enemy “Klangeist”.

FEATURING

  • The disc manipulated by BrebeMan is an offensive and defensive tool.

    At times it is a blade that slices the enemy,

    and at other times it is a shield that protects you.

    When you accumulate tension, you can "change the beat".

    "Change the Beat" attacks all enemies.

    A powerful boss awaits you at the end of each stage. Face them with all your might.

  • The music features a wide variety of club music styles,

    from classic to trendy, with drum'n'bass as the mainstay.

    Interactive sounds that progress according to the game enhance the game.

  • Starting with BrebeMan , various characters are represented in the collage.

    Vintage, vaporwave, retro-futuristic,

    and various other visuals invite you into an unknown world.
